source_evidence: Some annuities include implicit costs that are harder to identify, but also reduce the value of your annuity.
answer: Annuity costs can be explicit or implicit. Explicit fees are subtracted directly from the annuity’s value, and an account statement may show them. Implicit costs are less visible: they may appear as lower credited interest or limits on potential gains. Even when you do not receive a separate bill for them, implicit costs can reduce your return just as an explicit fee can.
